* Decipher's errata changes no words: “This Light Side character has a permanent weapon icon.” The game text above is the printed text.
* Bill's ruling (spec v10 §3, 22 November 2026): the Players Committee's D-E1 card, which shows the permanent weapon icon and the printed words, is accepted as the play card.

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Supplement (29 January 2002). Decipher never printed a card with this wording.
